clef.title: Clef Decision Model Playground
clef.description: Cloudflare's own open-weight decision model family: Clef (27B, now faster), Clef-flash (9B, now $0.038/M), and the new Clef-omni (30B MoE: text, image, audio, and video). Instead of generating text they return a probability for every option of every question — ideal for triage, moderation, and scoring. Pick a Taiwan customer scenario, the sample media loads automatically, then press Run.

guardrails.title: MCP Guardrails
guardrails.intro: SAP and Salesforce MCP traffic goes through the MCP Server Portal, then Cloudflare Gateway HTTP policies and DLP. Each scenario maps to one Gateway rule that blocks a tool call or response at a different level.
guardrails.flow1: Send the prompt that will be blocked while the rule is still off, and confirm the write to Salesforce succeeds
guardrails.flow2: Open the matching rule in the Dashboard
guardrails.flow3: After about 15 seconds, send the same prompt again and watch it get blocked
guardrails.s3Note: A FROM Contacts subquery used to bypass this; the regex was adjusted
guardrails.s4Note: Requires the upstream to return JSON; SSE streams are not scanned by DLP
